in_marathi.name: Lalman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lalman is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Lal' meaning 'God' and 'Man' meaning 'of the universe'. In Hindu mythology, Lalman is a manifestation of Lord Vishnu and is worshipped for his cosmic powers. He is believed to be the protector of the universe and the sustainer of life.
